branches.label: main
branches.description: The integration branch. Features merge here; changes are then promoted through environment branches.

branches.label: feature/*
branches.description: Short-lived branch opened as a merge request into main. Deleted after merge.

branches.label: pre-production
branches.description: An environment branch where the next release is validated before reaching production.

branches.label: production
branches.description: The environment branch representing the live deploy. Only promoted changes land here.

branches.label: release/*
branches.description: Optional branch cut from main to deliver an already-released version that must keep receiving fixes.

branches.label: hotfix/*
branches.description: Branches from production or main to fix a live incident immediately.
